notes: Account background: mid-tier UK financial services firm, multiple regulated products, heavy search usage across customer portal and internal knowledge base.
Primary ask: low-latency regional search (UK first, EU second) for RAG workflows; strict in-country data residency for user data and audit logs.
Scale: indexing target ~120M-250M docs initially; expect growth to 500M within 18 months. Vector index cardinality high (many short docs + metadata).
Latency SLOs: 95th percentile end-to-end query <120ms for user-facing search; reranker path (embedding + ANN + cross-encoder rerank) target 80-150ms depending on config.
Cost target: procurement looking for <$0.01 per query and ideally ~ $0.002-0.005 for common queries after batching/caching.
Model preferences: prefer open models for cost control; willing to evaluate quantized variants. Need support for hybrid pipelines: sparse retrieval + dense embeddings + learned reranker.
Routing/failover: must have multi-region routing with UK primary nodes; automatic failover to EU nodes if UK capacity degraded. Discussed sticky routing for session affinity.
Security: customer-managed KMS for encryption keys, full audit logs shipped to customer SIEM, SSO (SAML) integration for console access, records retention controls (7 years for some logs).
On-prem requirement: selected business units require an on-prem (air-gapped optional) deployment for certain datasets; need consistent API/rollout semantics between private and hosted modes.
Quote from CTO on 2024-12-02 call: "We cannot risk UK customer vectors leaving the region; latency and deterministic performance are non-negotiable."
POC plan: 2-week dedicated EU/UK POC using 2 shard clusters, sample 20M doc sync, measuring QPS, 95p latency, cache hit rates, and per-query cost estimates. SE to provide config templates.

Tech notes from SE: want to test prefix/KV caching for chat-like queries, evaluate quantization profiles with Redwood Optimize, and measure rerank cost with both cross-encoder and lightweight re-ranker.
Procurement timeline: security questionnaire in review (legal + infra teams); procurement expects internal signoff by Jan if POC meets SLOs.
Sales shorthand: strong EU/UK residency pain + scale. Potential 1-2 year enterprise contract. High-commercial + high-technical engagement.
Short-term action items: deliver security appendix, schedule POC kickoff (week of 2024-12-18), provide estimated cost model for 120M doc index at target QPS.
Notes style: fragmented; multiple stakeholders (CTO, Head of Infra, Compliance lead Emma Clarke).
Recent threads: compliance wants explicit data flow diagram and SOC2 evidence; infra asked for benchmarks vs OpenSearch and Pinecone for our rerank pipeline.

requirements_summary: Indexing scale: initial 120M-250M docs, growth to 500M+; need efficient shard and GC strategies
Embeddings: high throughput embed generation for nightly sync, on-the-fly small-batch embeddings for queries; prefer batched GPU inference
ANN Latency: ANN lookup + candidate fetch target 20-60ms in-region
Reranking: cross-encoder rerank for top-50 with target 50-120ms; fallback to lightweight re-ranker if SLOs breached
Caching: prefix/KV caching to reduce per-query cost for chat-like flows; warm-up strategies for peak windows
Routing: UK-primary routing, automatic EU failover, ability to pin sensitive indices to on-prem nodes
Operational: per-route latency + cost dashboards, audit logging retention export, and model/regression alerting.
